Why We Exist

We close the gap by giving you real work on real space-related projects.

Most people who love space don't know how to get involved. Space jobs feel distant and gated. Internships are limited. Many roles require specific schools, locations, or networks.
Meanwhile the space economy is expanding…

⊗
Gated Access

Breaking down barriers of geography and traditional networking.

◈
Real-World Impact

Transforming from theoretical knowledge to practical experience.

Built for Doers
  • Space Majors
  • Space Enthusiasts
  • Career changers & lifelong learners
  • No experience required!

How It Works

01. APPLY
Application & Intake

Tell us your story. Choose from project streams: FloBrain Space Buddy, MoodChanger, Space Travel Agency, robotics, or media.

02. CHOOSE
Choose Streams

Pick the project streams you want. We work in structured sprints. Ship work that plugs directly into live projects.

03. SPRINTS
Work in Sprints

Collaborate in project pods around your streams. Sprints are focused blocks of work with clear outcomes.

04. SHIP
Ship & Grow

Your time converts to skills, real-world outputs, and new opportunities as the ecosystem expands with new challenges.

Mission Core Activities

Hands-on Work

Real tasks related to FloBrain Space Buddy, the Space Travel Agency, humanoid and robotic platforms.

Multi-Experience

Depending on your profile, you might contribute to research, UX and UI, development, data, storytelling, or marketing.

Practical Exposure

Concrete contributions to live or in-development initiatives. Ideas are defined, proofed, positioned, and delivered, not just in theory.

Portfolio & Growth

Concrete contributions to five or in-development initiatives, a community of peers serious about space and AI, and the ability to join remotely.

What We Are Building
Right Now

These are the types of projects active around Space Ventures Institute real clusters of activity that participants can plug into.

FloBrain as a Space Buddy

Exploring how the FloBrain can support space tourists and future crews, plus a consumer app and space inspiration feed.

  • •Companion, information, and coaching concepts for analog astronauts.
  • •Long-term vision for how a Space Buddy could assist future crews.
Status: Research Phase

FloBrain Consumer App

Researching how FloBrain can exist as a consumer-facing app that curates space news and acts as a personal space guide.

  • •Curates space news, discoveries, and mission updates
  • •Acts as a personal space guide with daily insights
  • •Bridges entertainment, education, and career inspiration
View Repository →

MoodChanger for Space Health

Adapting MoodChanger for space-related use cases: stress, mood, and sleep tracking for people in demanding space-adjacent skills.

Travel Agency & Marketplace

Building an online, remote-first Space Travel Agency that curates and sells existing and upcoming space tourism experiences.

Humanoid & Robotics

Developing and exploring robotic platforms with a space angle. Internal R&D on humanoid robots connected to the Space Ventures narrative.

Space Media & Events

Designing an online Space Ventures Conference and content that focuses on the intersection of space, AI, robotics, health, and travel.

Websites & Presence

Improving and creating websites for Space Ventures Institute, the Space Travel Agency, RoboCollective.ai, and related projects.

Grants & Funding

Researching and applying for grants aligned with space, AI, robotics, health and education. Collaboration routes for funded initiatives.

About

FloLabs Innovations

The FloLabs Innovations Group Internship will have you buzzing for a few key reasons, they all hinge on the exciting intersection of AI, robotics, entrepreneurship, and various technical domains.

Flexible. Dynamic. Inspiring.

FloLabs Innovations Group Internships offer flexible schedules, live and recorded sessions, and hands-on experience in cutting-edge AI and technology projects.

100%
Learn Creatively
FAST
Learn & Grow
Entrepreneurial DNA

Every engineer is a founder. Every founder is a builder.

The Flo Ecosystem

Everything connected: space, deep learning, and tech in a single unified directory.

Core Missions

Mission 01

Build the Future of Travel With AI

You will be chomping at the bit to contribute to an AI-powered travel agent that personalizes experiences with cutting-edge NLP techniques. Imagine crafting an app that understands complex travel requests and leverages real-time data to create dynamic itineraries.

The chance to integrate multimodal transportation with Generative AI, seamlessly combining flights, trains, ferries, and carpooling into optimized travel packages.

Mission 02

Pushing Boundaries of AI Research

The opportunity to delve into AGI (Artificial General Intelligence) research is a dream come true. It's the holy grail of AI, and being involved will be an incredible learning experience. We are eager to absorb our knowledge and understanding of AI's theoretical underpinnings.

Mission 03

Revolutionize Industries With AI

The prospect of working on projects that leverage AI for personalized learning and improved educational outcomes is inspiring. Imagine AI tutors that adapt to individual needs, that's a game-changer.

Contributing to advancements in healthcare through AI-powered diagnostics, robotic surgery, and neurotechnology is enormously exciting.

The Bottom Line

We move innovation through the deeply iterative programs in a global opportunity. Gaining in-depth knowledge of the latest advancements and real-world applications of AI is essential.

The program will equip you with the skills to navigate the evolving landscape of AI and position you for a future shaped by these technologies.

Working in a collaborative environment that fosters creativity through AI-powered tools and gamification is invigorating.
